## Accordion

## Token Input

Mix editable text with tokens for files, people, tags, and other references.

Structure:
```
TokenInput
├── TokenInputEditor
└── TriggerMenu
```

```
<state prompt={["Summarize the launch notes"]} />

</TokenInput>
```

Bind state with: `bind:value`

State attributes for CSS: `TokenInputEditor` `[data-empty]` `[data-disabled]` `[data-readonly]`; `TokenInputToken` `[data-token-type]` `[data-pending]` `[data-disabled]` `[data-readonly]` `[data-selected]`; `TokenInputTokenRemove` `[data-disabled]` `[data-readonly]`

## Tree

Browse a hierarchy of files, pages, or choices with expandable branches.

Structure:
```
Tree
├── TreeItem
│   ├── TreeItemLabel

│   └── TreeGroup
│       └── TreeItem
│           └── TreeItemLabel
└── TreeItem
    └── TreeItemLabel

```

```
  <TreeItem value="src">
    <TreeItemLabel>
      <TreeItemIndicator>›</TreeItemIndicator>

    <TreeGroup>
      <TreeItem value="src/index.ts">
        <TreeItemLabel>index.ts</TreeItemLabel>
      </TreeItem>
    </TreeGroup>
  </TreeItem>
  <TreeItem value="package.json">
    <TreeItemLabel>package.json</TreeItemLabel>
  </TreeItem>
</Tree>
```

State attributes for CSS: `TreeItem` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-indeterminate]` `[data-selected]`; `TreeItemLabel` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-selected]` `[data-current]`; `TreeItemIndicator` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-loading]` `[data-failed]`; `TreeItemCheckbox` `[data-indeterminate]` `[data-checked]` `[data-unchecked]`; `TreeGroup` `[data-open]` `[data-closed]`

## Trigger Menu

Opens suggestions at the caret when you type a trigger such as @, /, or #.

Parts: `TriggerMenu`, `TriggerMenuContent`, `TriggerMenuEmpty`, `TriggerMenuGroup`, `TriggerMenuGroupLabel`, `TriggerMenuHint`, `TriggerMenuInput`, `TriggerMenuItem`, `TriggerMenuItemIcon`, `TriggerMenuItems`, `TriggerMenuList`, `TriggerMenuSeparator`, `TriggerMenuStatus`

Structure:
```
TriggerMenu
├── TriggerMenuInput
├── TriggerMenuStatus
└── TriggerMenuContent
    ├── TriggerMenuEmpty
    └── TriggerMenuList
        ├── TriggerMenuItem
        └── TriggerMenuItem
```

Example:
```
<TriggerMenu triggers={[{ char: "@" }]}>
  <TriggerMenuInput
    aria-label="Message"
    placeholder="Type @ to mention someone…"
  />
  <TriggerMenuContent>
    <TriggerMenuList>
      <TriggerMenuItem value="hollis" label="Hollis Grant">
        Hollis Grant
      </TriggerMenuItem>
      <TriggerMenuItem value="ines" label="Inès Moreau">
        Inès Moreau
      </TriggerMenuItem>
    </TriggerMenuList>
  </TriggerMenuContent>
</TriggerMenu>
```

Bind state with: `bind:open`

State attributes for CSS: `TriggerMenuInput` `[data-closed]` `[data-open]` `[data-trigger]`; `TriggerMenuContent` `[data-closed]` `[data-starting-style]` `[data-ending-style]` `[data-side]` `[data-align]`; `TriggerMenuItem` `[data-disabled]` `[data-highlighted]` `[data-has-icon]`; `TriggerMenuEmpty` `[data-empty]` `[data-loading]`; `TriggerMenuItemIcon` `[data-mirror]`

## Waterfall

Show a trace or a page's requests as bars on a shared time axis, with spans that expand to show what they started.

Parts: `Waterfall`, `WaterfallAxis`, `WaterfallBar`, `WaterfallCell`, `WaterfallColumnHeader`, `WaterfallHeaderRow`, `WaterfallIndicator`, `WaterfallMark`, `WaterfallRow`, `WaterfallRowHeader`, `WaterfallTick`

Structure:
```
Waterfall
├── WaterfallHeaderRow
│   ├── WaterfallColumnHeader
│   └── WaterfallColumnHeader
│       ├── WaterfallAxis
│       │   └── WaterfallTick
│       └── WaterfallMark
├── WaterfallRow
│   ├── WaterfallRowHeader
│   │   └── WaterfallIndicator
│   ├── WaterfallCell
│   └── WaterfallBar
└── WaterfallRow
    ├── WaterfallRowHeader
    └── WaterfallBar
```

Example:
```
<state requests={[
  { value: "html", label: "index.html", start: 0, duration: 120 },
  { value: "css", label: "app.css", start: 90, duration: 60 }
]} />
<Waterfall aria-label="Network requests" items={requests}>
  {#each requests as request (request.value)}
    <WaterfallRow value={request.value}>
      <WaterfallRowHeader>{request.label}</WaterfallRowHeader>
      <WaterfallBar />
    </WaterfallRow>
  {/each}
</Waterfall>
```

Bind state with: `bind:value`, `bind:expanded`

State attributes for CSS: `WaterfallMark` `[data-outside]`; `WaterfallRow` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-selected]`; `WaterfallRowHeader` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-selected]`; `WaterfallIndicator` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]`; `WaterfallCell` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-selected]`; `WaterfallBar` `[data-level]` `[data-branch]` `[data-expanded]` `[data-selected]`
